create_TransfoXLModel: create a Transformer-XL model with relative position embeddings and memory for long-context language modeling
create_TransfoXLLMHeadModel: create a Transformer-XL language model with adaptive softmax head and tied weights for next-token prediction
build_tf_to_pytorch_map: build a mapping from TensorFlow module names to PyTorch model parameters for weight loading
load_tf_weights_in_transfo_xl: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch Transformer-XL model
test_TransfoXLModel_forward: test the TransfoXLModel forward pass with input_ids and optional memory states for sequential decoding
